summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on enhancements to the REST specification, including proposals for generic identifiers and passing arbitrary information. Additionally, the Iceberg 1.11.0 release is addressing blockers related to licensing and Spark bugs, while ongoing discussions explore efficient column updates and aggregate column statistics.
highlights: Proposal to add relative paths to v4 spec
Discussion on constraint support in Iceberg
Efforts to resolve blockers for Iceberg 1.11.0 release
